title: DashGPT — DASH
intro: Developer operational handoff. Keep this short and grounded in repository/PR evidence. Canonical product language is Card; existing `Result` names are implementation compatibility vocabulary.

sections.title: NOW
lines: **Active delivery:** card-first product consolidation plus independent open feature work.
- Current `develop` contains merged implementation through Feature 17 / PR #32.
- PR #33 (`f18-unified-card-dashboard`) is an open draft for the unified Card / `My Dash` surface; it is not merged.
- PR #34 (`f19-project-local-developer-memory`) is an open project-local developer-memory prototype; it is not merged.
- Documentation/OpenSpec source-of-truth reconciliation is updating README/docs/OpenSpec guidance without changing production behavior.
- Feature 4 public ChatGPT App release remains an external submission/approval/second-user acceptance track.
- Feature 6 GitHub production activation still requires protected Worker secrets plus one real private-repository acceptance smoke test.

sections.title: NEXT
lines: 1. Keep PR #33 and PR #34 independent; merge only after their own OpenSpec and verification gates pass.
2. After any merge, reconcile roadmap/OpenSpec/DASH and do not present branch-only behavior as current `develop` before that point.
3. Configure `GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` and `GITHUB_SESSION_SECRET` through protected Cloudflare secret handling when resuming Feature 6 activation.
4. Run the real private disposable-repository pair → sync → no-op re-sync → disconnect acceptance test before calling GitHub sync activated.
5. Resume Feature 4 public submission/review/publication and second-user acceptance as an external track when desired.

6. Keep mobile demo, direct capture, bulk browser import, card merge, additional storage providers, localization and semantic navigation as separate future Issue/OpenSpec/PR scopes unless already active.

sections.title: BLOCKERS / EXTERNAL HINGES
lines: - Feature 6 production GitHub activation depends on protected secret configuration and a real private-repository smoke test.
- GitHub App private key/session secret must never be pasted into chat, committed to Git or serialized into DashGPT memory.
- Feature 4 public availability depends on external platform submission/review/approval and second-user acceptance.
- Open PR #33/#34 behavior is not available on `develop` until merged.
- Stable deployment/product verification must remain separate from merge/CI state.

sections.title: RULES FOR THIS DASH
lines: - This file is a developer operational handoff, not a second product model.
- Product requirements live in `docs/product-summary.md`; OpenSpec scopes implementation changes.
- Card is the canonical user-facing memory entity; legacy `Result` identifiers remain literal implementation compatibility names where they still exist.
- Update after meaningful implementation merge, deployment, architecture decision, blocker or external manual step.
- Keep **DONE / NOW / NEXT / BLOCKERS** separate.
- Keep `demo/data/dash.json` synchronized with this file; CI must reject drift.
- Do not infer shipped behavior from an issue, OpenSpec proposal, open PR or prototype.
- Prefer links/PR numbers/change IDs over long narrative history.
